fields.value: Additional file 5 of Single cell characterization of B-lymphoid differentiation and leukemic cell states during chemotherapy in ETV6-RUNX1-positive pediatric leukemia identifies drug-targetable transcription factor activities

dsDescriptionValue.value: Additional file 5: Table S4. Supporting information related to SCENIC analysis. Summary of regulons discovered in healthy BM B-lineage analysis (related to Fig. 2) and the related validation motif analysis results using pro-B ATAC-seq and regulon target gene analysis for PAX5, EBF1 and BCL11A, including respective ChIP-seq peak data used in validation. Summary of regulons discovered upon including ALL cell states and summary of statistical analysis comparing E/R+ to non-E/R ALL based on bulk RNA-seq (related to Fig. 5).
